title: Area Under a Curve
page_title: Area Under a Curve | Edexcel International A Level (IAL) Maths Revision Notes 2020

blocks.text: What is the area under a curve?

blocks.md:
- The phrase “area under a curve” refers to the area bounded by …

  - ... the **x**-axis
  - … the graph of **y = f(x)**
  - … the vertical line **x = a**
  - … the vertical line **x = b**

blocks.alt: Notes fig1, AS & A Level Maths revision notes

blocks.text: How do I find the area under a curve using definite integration?

blocks.alt: Notes fig2, AS & A Level Maths revision notes

blocks.md: - The value from **definite** **integration** is equal to the “area under a curve” ![Notes fig3, AS & A Level Maths revision notes](assets/334f1688ae7c-8-1-4-notes-fig3.png)

blocks.text: How do I find the limits of integration?

blocks.alt: Notes fig4, AS & A Level Maths revision notes

blocks.md:
- If limits are not provided they will be the **x**-axis intercepts

  - Set **y = 0** and solve the equation to find the **x**-axis intercepts

blocks.alt: Notes fig5, AS & A Level Maths revision notes

blocks.text: How do I find areas that are below the x-axis (negative areas)?

blocks.alt: Notes fig6, A Level & AS Level Pure Maths Revision Notes

blocks.md:
- If the area lies underneath the **x**-axis the value of the integral will be negative
- An **area** cannot be negative, so take the **modulus** of the integral

blocks.alt: Notes fig7, AS & A Level Maths revision notes

blocks.text: How do I find total areas without areas cancelling each other out?

blocks.alt: Notes fig8, A Level & AS Level Pure Maths Revision Notes

blocks.md:
- Be careful when one section is above and one section is below the **x**-axis ![Notes fig9, A Level & AS Level Pure Maths Revision Notes](assets/18e9c3a0bb9a-8-1-4-notes-fig9.png)

  - You will need a separate integral for each section, BUT...
  - ...One section's integral will be **negative**
  - ...One section's integral will be **positive**
  - So you’ll need to take the **modulus** before adding to find the total area

blocks.label: Exam Hint
blocks.md:
- Add information to any diagram provided in the question, as well as axes intercepts and values of limits.
- Mark and shade the area you’re trying to find, and if no diagram is provided, **sketch** one!
